description: Returns a room's chat messages, newest first. Private user content: read it only when the developer asks to review a room. To take a message down: neblla_delete_room_message.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

before.description: Id or date of the oldest message already seen: returns older ones.

name.description: The room's name as neblla_list_rooms shows it.

name: neblla_get_room_history
title: Read a room's chat
